title: cBCI Matrix Multimodal Dataset
description: This dataset comprises simultaneous EEG and eye-tracking recordings from 21 participants performing a matrix-based brain-computer interface (BCI) typing task using a single-character-presentation paradigm. Data were collected at Northeastern University in 2023 using the BciPy software platform, including calibration and copy-spelling sessions with event markers for target and non-target stimuli. The dataset supports research on multimodal sensor fusion for EEG-based BCI typing systems.
methods_description: EEG data were collected using a DSI-24 dry electrode cap (Wearable Sensing) at 300 Hz sampling rate, with electrodes at Fp1/2, Fz, F3/4, F7/8, Cz, C3/4, T7/T8, T3/T4, Pz, P3/P4, P7/P8, T5/T6, O1/2, referenced to linked ears (A1/A2). Eye-tracking data were collected using a Tobii Pro Nano at 60 Hz. The matrix paradigm and data acquisition were managed with BciPy software. Calibration tasks presented letters at 4 Hz across 100 inquiries of 10 letters each (1 target, 9 non-target), with timing verified via a photodiode and Matrix Time Test Task.
